title: Judge blocks X rival from using Twitter name, but allows ‘Tweet’ for now
summary: A federal judge temporarily barred an X rival from using the Twitter name, but found that X was likely to have abandoned the “Tweet” trademark and bird logo. The startup has since relaunched as Tweet.app.
llm_summary: A federal judge has issued a temporary injunction that stops the X‑rival startup from branding itself as “Twitter,” but the court allowed it to keep using the “Tweet” name and its bird logo—for now—because X appears to have abandoned those trademarks. The decision clears the way for the company
